description: Sends a PUT request with JSON body to the specified API endpoint with Bearer token authentication.
code:
def put_json_async(token, url, json_body):
    return reporter.record(requests.put(url, headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}", "Content-Type": "application/json", "Accept": "application/json"}, data=json_body))
comments: Standard PUT request helper with Bearer token authentication

description: Validates a create/standard response: passes on HTTP 200 or 201, writing a PASS/FAIL line. Returns true on pass.
code:
def validate_success_200_201_async(response):
    code = response.status_code
    passed = code in (200, 201)
    print(f"PASS: status {code}" if passed else f"FAIL: expected 200 or 201 but got {code}")
    return passed
comments: Validates API response status and content for test assertions

description: Validates the response (passes on HTTP 200 or 201, writing a PASS/FAIL line) and then returns a value from the JSON body by path — so a create step needs no separate validate. Supports nested objects and array indices (e.g. "id", "data.id", "data[0].id", "items.0.customer.id") so you can select a specific value when several are returned. Assign the result to a variable such as responseValue.
Returns the Stripe API host (https://api.stripe.com). Endpoint paths already include the /v1 prefix, so the base path is the host only.
code:
def stripe_base_url():
    return "https://api.stripe.com"

description: Sends a DELETE to a URL template, substituting a captured value into its {..} placeholder. The value is generic (id, account number, etc.) so the placeholder name does not matter.
Validates a delete response: passes on HTTP 200 or 204, writing a PASS/FAIL line. Returns true on pass.
code:
def validate_deleted_200_204_async(response):
    code = response.status_code
    passed = code in (200, 204)
    print(f"PASS (delete): status {code}" if passed else f"FAIL (delete): expected 200 or 204 but got {code}")
    return passed

comments: Petstore base path for E2E suites/test cases.

description: Returns the Petstore api_key. Defaults to the public demo key 'special-key'; override with the PETSTORE_API_KEY environment variable.
code:
def pet_store_api_key():
    return os.environ.get("PETSTORE_API_KEY") or "special-key"
comments: Note: Petstore uses an api_key header; the Bearer wrappers still work against the permissive public instance.
